task.subject: Secret-leak detections produced by the githubnext/gh-cao secret-leak review workflow
task.intent: Determine whether the secret-leak review workflow activates on bounded threat-detection findings, executes reliably, creates one accepted issue for each eligible detection, and attains its native review-acknowledgement objective without treating a successful run as accepted repository evidence.
activationConditions: The standalone .github/workflows/secret-leak-review.yml workflow is enabled in review mode for githubnext/gh-cao.
A retained security-findings observation for that workflow has smell-id threat-detection-secret-leak and high severity.
The observation has a stable smell-observation-id, run provenance, and evidence link, creating one review opportunity.
requiredEffects: For each eligible opportunity, the workflow emits at most one issue safe output that identifies the exact detection without exposing secret material.
The accepted repository effect is an issue outcome attributed to the same repository, workflow, run, and stable detection opportunity.
The dashboard preserves security-finding evidence, execution conclusion, safe-output outcome state, and native operational-value observations as distinct evidence.
noopConditions: No eligible threat-detection-secret-leak finding exists in the selected horizon.
The finding lacks stable identity, run provenance, or a safe evidence link.
An accepted issue outcome already covers the same stable detection opportunity.
Required source evidence is unavailable; an empty view must not be interpreted as no detections.
successConditions: Every matured eligible detection has exactly one accepted issue outcome with matching repository, workflow, run, and opportunity identity.
Operators can navigate from each detection and issue outcome to retained evidence without revealing secret payloads.
The native secret-leak-review-attainment metric is preserved as a ratio in [0,1], with null remaining distinct from zero.
uncertainties: A successful workflow run does not prove that an issue safe output was accepted.
A pending, ignored, or rejected issue outcome does not establish review acknowledgement.
Missing findings, outcomes, or operational-value observations do not establish zero opportunities or zero attainment.

opportunity.binding: Each hypothetical run binds only to the retained high-severity threat-detection-secret-leak finding whose stable identity and run provenance were supplied at activation.

acceptedEvidence: A canonical security-findings row with smell-id threat-detection-secret-leak, high severity, stable smell-observation-id, run provenance, and evidence-link.
Exactly one canonical outcomes row for an issue safe output in accepted state, attributed to the same repository, workflow, run, and opportunity.
The gh-aw operational-value observation published for the same bounded opportunity and metric contract.
operationalValue.attainment: For matured eligible opportunities, the number with exactly one accepted matching issue outcome divided by the number of matured eligible opportunities.

baseline.reason: This synthetic design has no immutable comparable pre-adoption evidence.

operationalValue.maturationRule: An opportunity matures only after the safe-output outcome for its bound run is terminal and the cutoff has passed; pending or unavailable outcomes remain unmatured.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Publish numeric zero only when at least one eligible opportunity has matured and none has exactly one accepted matching issue outcome.
operationalValue.missingEvidenceRule: Publish null when the eligible denominator, finding provenance, terminal outcome, repository attribution, or metric evidence is missing or unavailable; do not coerce null to zero.
operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the upstream metric ID, ordering, native finite value or null, ratio unit, higher-is-better direction, and [0,1] contract exactly as published by gh-aw.

fixturePurpose: Schema-only empty logical sources exercise honest empty and missing-evidence states without fabricating a run, finding, safe output, or attainment observation.
